translations.web: “You, son of man, will you judge? Will you judge the bloody city? Then cause her to know all her abominations.
translations.bsb: “As for you, son of man, will you judge her? Will you pass judgment on the city of bloodshed? Then confront her with all her abominations
translations.kjv: Now, thou son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? yea, thou shalt shew her all her abominations.
translations.asv: And thou, son of man, wilt thou judge, wilt thou judge the bloody city? then cause her to know all her abominations.
